propositions: The portability criterion's detection text must explicitly name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' in the Platform and venue matrix cell so that hard CI dependencies become detectable findings.
A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule with no fallback) is not portable and must be flagged as a project.portability finding.
The authoritative wording resides in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md; docs/plan-review-gate.md mirrors it and must stay in sync, with both versions pinned by unit tests.
AGENTS.md must gain a single one-line pointer to the new rule, cross-linking rebar explain and docs/plan-review-gate.md without restating rubric text.
Live A/B testing against a GitHub-Actions-only compaction trigger with no operation-linked fallback must emit a project.portability finding with the new rubric and none with the old rubric.
